identity: A UB spells-matter control deck where the interaction suite IS the cost reduction. Thirteen of its twenty-two nonland cards are instants or sorceries, and three separate cards read that number: Tolarian Terror's cost, Haughty Djinn's power, and kicked Tribute to Urborg's size. What separates this build from an ordinary Terror deck is that it does not try to win with two ground 5/5s. Seven bodies deal damage and four of them cannot be blocked profitably - Haunting Figment x2 are unblockable on any turn the deck casts a spell, Haughty Djinn and Sphinx of Clear Skies fly. The deck answers on curve for one and two mana, is paid for having done so, and closes around turn 8.

mainboard.name: Cut Down
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature with total power and toughness 5 or less.

mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {2}{B} (You may pay an additional {2}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature or planeswalker you don't control to its owner's hand. If this spell was kicked, put that permanent on the bottom of its owner's library instead.

mainboard.name: Tribute to Urborg
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{U} (You may pay an additional {1}{U} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.

mainboard.name: Extinguish the Light
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. If its mana value was 3 or less, you gain 3 life.

mainboard.name: Founding the Third Path
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 1 or 2 from your hand without paying its mana cost.
II — Target player mills four cards.
III — Exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy.
mainboard.role: Engine — free spell, mill four, graveyard rebuy

mainboard.name: Impulse
mainboard.oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

mainboard.name: Cosmic Epiphany
mainboard.oracle_text: Draw cards equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.

mainboard.oracle_text:
Vigilance

mainboard.role: Threat — evasive clock, unblockable on spell turns

mainboard.oracle_text:

An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard. (Piles can be empty.)

mainboard.oracle_text:

Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)

mainboard.name: Contaminated Aquifer
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {U} or {B}.)
This land enters tapped.

sideboard.name: Negate
sideboard.when_to_board: The only answer this deck has to the cube's 18 enchantments and 15 artifacts, since no mono-blue or mono-black card in this pool destroys either after it resolves. Also protects Haughty Djinn and the Terrors from removal on the stack.

sideboard.name: Ertai's Scorn
sideboard.oracle_text:
This spell costs {U} less to cast if an opponent cast two or more spells this turn.
Counter target spell.
sideboard.when_to_board: In vs control mirrors and noncreature threats where Essence Scatter's creature-only clause is dead.

sideboard.name: Battlefly Swarm
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flying
{B}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In vs the cube's 30 flying creatures. For {B} it blocks any flier, and '{B}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn' kills it regardless of size — something the ground-bound Tolarian Terror structurally cannot do.

sideboard.name: Academy Wall
sideboard.oracle_text:
Defender
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In vs ground aggro. Its trigger fires off the 13 instants and sorceries in the mainboard, so it loots while it walls.

sideboard.name: Knight of Dusk's Shadow
sideboard.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Your opponents can't gain life.
{1}{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In vs the cube's 22 lifegain cards (the third-largest threat class at 8.9% density). 'Your opponents can't gain life' shuts the class off entirely, and a 2/2 with menace and a {1}{B} pump adds to a clock that is built to deal exactly 20.

sideboard.name: Drag to the Bottom
sideboard.oracle_text: Domain — Each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.
sideboard.when_to_board: In vs genuinely wide boards, the one class the mainboard concedes. At this deck's 2 basic land types it is -3/-3, killing 106 of the cube's 157 creatures while only 3 of this deck's 7 bodies die (Haunting Figment x2 and Ertai Resurrected); Haughty Djinn survives at */1 because its toughness is a fixed 4, and Sphinx of Clear Skies and Tolarian Terror x2 survive at 2/2. Board it in alongside cutting the Figments.

identity_es: Un control UB de los hechizos importan donde el paquete de interacción ES la reducción de coste. Trece de sus veintidós cartas no-tierra son instantáneos o conjuros, y tres cartas distintas leen ese número: el coste de Tolarian Terror, la fuerza de Haughty Djinn, y el tamaño del Tribute to Urborg kickeado. Lo que separa esta construcción de un mazo de Terror normal es que no intenta ganar con dos 5/5 terrestres. Siete cuerpos hacen daño y cuatro de ellos no pueden bloquearse con provecho: Haunting Figment x2 son imbloqueables en cualquier turno en que el mazo lance un hechizo, y Haughty Djinn y Sphinx of Clear Skies vuelan. El mazo responde en curva por uno y dos manás, cobra por haberlo hecho, y cierra hacia el turno 8.
